facts.label: Relativa sem pronome
facts.sub: Quando o substantivo é objeto, use sujeito + verbo logo depois: the book I read, the woman you met. Não repita o objeto e mantenha a preposição no fim.

facts.label: Sem pronome
facts.sub: Quando o objeto vem antes, o pronome pode sumir: the book I read, the song you like. Em inglês do dia a dia isso é muito comum. Basta colocar o sujeito depois do substantivo.

facts.label: Quando omitir
facts.sub: Omita that, which ou who só quando a palavra seguinte for um sujeito (I, you, she). The woman I know. Se vier um verbo logo depois, o pronome fica: the woman who lives here.

pages.title: Mito ou fato? · 1/2

items.s: We can leave out that in “the book I read”.
items.why: Yes, when it is the object.

items.s: We can leave out who in “the woman who lives here”.
items.why: Who is the subject there, so we keep it.

pages.instruction: Decida e explique com suas palavras.

solo: Aluno responde e justifica; você mostra a pista.
group: Cada aluno decide sozinho, depois compare as respostas e peça uma justificativa.
Corrija pela pista do texto, não só dizendo “certo/errado”.
extra90: Peça que cada aluno invente uma pergunta igual para o colega.
answers: We can leave out that in “the book I read”. → Verdadeiro (Yes, when it is the object.)
We can leave out who in “the woman who lives here”. → Falso (Who is the subject there, so we keep it.)
“The notebook you’re holding” is correct. → Verdadeiro (Yes.)

pages.title: A city library · 1/3
paragraphs: It is a cold Saturday morning in Calgary. Snow covers the street outside the library. Mia waits by the door with a small notebook. She wants to borrow another book today. Her friend Dale arrives with two cups of coffee. He asks about the story he lent her.
“Hi, Mia! Did you like the book I gave you?” says Dale. “I loved it! It’s the best story I’ve read this year.” says Mia. “Great! Is that the notebook you’re holding?” says Dale.
